subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Arctic foxes are small mammals native to the Arctic regions.
• A variant in their MC1R gene produces dense undercoat fur.
• A variant in their TRPM8 gene enhances cold temperature sensitivity.
• These genetic variants enable the foxes to survive in extremely cold environments.
• In a 2018 study, Cindy Yardley and colleagues noted that Arctic wolves' DNA has the same MC1R and TRPM8 variants.
• Yardley and colleagues determined that the foxes first acquired these variants by hybridizing with Arctic wolves around 15,000 years ago.
prompt: The student wants to present the conclusion of Cindy Yardley and colleagues' 2018 study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Like Arctic foxes, Arctic wolves can survive in extremely cold environments.
choices.B: By hybridizing with Arctic wolves around 15,000 years ago, Arctic foxes acquired the genetic variants that enable them to survive in extremely cold environments.
choices.C: Both Arctic foxes and Arctic wolves have variants in their MC1R and TRPM8 genes, which produce dense undercoat fur and enhance cold temperature sensitivity, respectively.
choices.D: In addition to producing dense undercoat fur, a variant in Arctic foxes' TRPM8 gene enhances cold temperature sensitivity.

explanation:
Choice B is correct. It presents the conclusion: Arctic foxes survive extreme cold due to hybridization with Arctic wolves 15,000 years ago that provided necessary genetic variants.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence misrepresents information from the notes by indicating that a variant in foxes' TRPM8 gene produces dense undercoat fur; moreover, it doesn't present the conclusions of the 2018 study.
